title: AMD XDNA NPU Probe
setup_instructions:
VitisAI execution provider not found. To enable AMD XDNA NPU inference:
  1. pip install onnxruntime-vitisai
  2. Install Vitis AI runtime from https://github.com/amd/RyzenAI-SW
     (follow the NPU EP quickstart for your OS/kernel version)
  3. Set XLNX_VART_FIRMWARE to the NPU firmware binary path.
  4. Verify: python -c "import onnxruntime; print(onnxruntime.get_available_providers())"
     Expected: [..., 'VitisAIExecutionProvider', ...]
